info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API facilitates the retrieval of checkout information for parking reservations. This API allows users to access detailed records of active and past parking checkouts, making it essential for managing reservations effectively. Typical consumers include parking management systems, customer support teams, and administrative services that require insights into reservation statuses. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer experience and streamline operational workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the necessary information to complete the checkout for a reservation. It provides details about the reservation status, available payment options, and any other relevant information required for finalizing the reservation.

requestBody.description: Request body for the checkout process in the reservations module. This operation allows the user to finalize their reservation and proceed with the checkout. Ensure that all required information is included in the JSON payload.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the reservation details.

ListParkingReservationsCheckoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the checkout operation in the reservations API. It is expected to be a simple string.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the checkout operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListParkingReservationsCheckoutsResponse.description: Response schema for the checkout operation.
